user.title: Add a coffee machine
user.description: Pick the smart plug your machine is plugged into and the sensor that reports its current (or power) draw.

data_description.power_entity: Usually the plug's current (A) or power (W) sensor.
data_description.threshold: Readings at or above this (same units as the sensor) mean the heater is on. Check the sensor's history while the machine heats to choose a value.
data_description.sleep_timeout: How long after its last heating or use the machine goes into standby by itself.
data_description.wake_off_seconds: When waking, the plug is switched off for this long and then back on.
data_description.min_heating_seconds: High current shorter than this is a burst (top-up or shot) rather than real heating. Only real heating wakes a sleeping machine.
data_description.activity_window_seconds: Short bursts that start within this long of the previous heating or shot count as using the machine and restart the sleep timer. Isolated bursts are top-ups and are ignored. 0 disables.

abort.already_configured: That smart plug is already set up as a coffee machine.
